'''Sk'rirak''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Tarong]]. Along with her brother, [[K'derek]], K'derek worked with the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] as [[Spy/Legends|information gatherers]].
